title: RWB-S7-E6027-APP: the post charge-off recovery has no REST operation, no published event name, no fee column and no screen state, and the plan's C row is empty while two rows and one event are consumed
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.3 and R9; split plan slices RWB-S7-E6027-APP and RWB-S7-E6027-CON; context pack S7 rwb-writeoff (service row, ownership rows, naming rules, Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13, Temporal and Drools slides 5, 12 and 13); legacy RWB-E6-027; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A1.1, A1.2, A1.4, A2.15 and Screens; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T2, T3.0, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.1, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1, T6.2, T7, T-A.1 and T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-37, R-WO-49 and R-WO-50; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 rows FEAT-WOF-15, FEAT-WOF-16 and FEAT-PRM-06, FEAT-PRM-07
description: (1) No source publishes an operation for the recovery. TSD S7 T-A.1 lists only POST /write-off-scans (API-S7-001, right C) and POST /write-offs/{writeOffId}/committee-decision (API-S7-002, right A), and the legacy Endpoints table repeats those same two rows for every S7 story, so the act has no operation of its own. (2) The trigger is a payment event of rwb-payment: the connection matrix row S7 gives P8 'T E', but TSD S7 T5.3 names only WriteOffApproved as published and no source gives the consumed event a name or a payload. (3) The income posting to ALS and the general ledger is an integration point of FSD S7 A2.15.2 while TSD S7 T5.1 publishes no external interface and T5.2 names no integration module, so the posting is carried as the postProceeds activity of P8 (Temporal and Drools slide 12) with no published activity name. (4) R-WO-37 asks to 'calculate the agency fee' and write_off has no fee column: TSD S7 T3.1 gives DF-FIN-010 to DF-FIN-020 and none is a fee, so the fee reference lives in the decision record only. (5) The recovery is published nowhere: EV-24 WriteOffApproved is the approval path's and rwb-reporting listens to S7 events, so the reporting read model would miss every post charge-off recovery. (6) SCR-27's legacy states are Scan; proposed; in committee; approved, and no state shows a post charge-off recovery at population level. (7) The plan gives H = RWB-S7-E6027-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON with C, I and X empty, while the story consumes two REST rows and one event, and DP-04, DP-07, DP-09 and DP-16 are absent from the pattern set although the sources name the Drools kit, reference data, the inbox and the integration adapter.
evidence: split plan slice RWB-S7-E6027-APP with three H rows and empty C, I and X; TSD S7 T-A.1 operations API-S7-001 and API-S7-002 only, T-A.2 with no recovery operation, T3.1 list of DF-FIN-010 to DF-FIN-020 with no fee field, T5.1 with no external interface, T5.2 naming P3 to P7 only, T5.3 naming WriteOffApproved only; FSD S7 A2.15.2 integration points ALS and GL, A2.15.4 criteria; legacy RWB-E6-027 Endpoints, Data and Screen tables; context pack naming rules, connection matrix row S7 and Temporal and Drools slide 12 activity contracts; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-04, DP-07, DP-09 and DP-16 rows
area: Contract surface, event name and payload, fee field, reporting event, screen state, dependency rows
proposed: Declare the act as event-driven with no operation of the step and no publication of its own; consume the P8 event on rwb.payment.events.v1 with a placeholder name and payload and derive the element from the published document; read the ACE facts on the rwb-source-data contract; read the fee schedule as reference data on the rwb-case contract and carry the fee reference in the decision record only; post the income through the postProceeds activity on the P8 queue; raise the reporting gap and propose one recovery event on rwb.writeoff.events.v1 without naming it here; keep the plan's H, C, I and X rows as they stand and record the C rows in fact

title: RWB-S7-E6027-CON: the consumed event, the two consumed operation names, the posting activity name, the fee element and the case-move answer have no published baseline, and the step publishes no event
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.3 and R9; split plan slices RWB-S7-E6027-APP and RWB-S7-E6027-CON; context pack S7 rwb-writeoff (service row, ownership rows, naming rules, Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13, Temporal and Drools slides 5, 12 and 13); legacy RWB-E6-027; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A1.1, A1.2, A1.4, A2.15 and Screens; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T2, T3.0, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.1, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1, T6.2, T7, T-A.1 and T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-37, R-WO-49 and R-WO-50; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 rows FEAT-WOF-15, FEAT-WOF-16 and FEAT-PRM-06, FEAT-PRM-07
description: (1) The consumed payment event has no published name, topic element or payload in any source this story may read: the naming rule gives the topic rwb.payment.events.v1 and the shape rwb.payment.<Event>.v1, and nothing gives the Event token, the properties or the CloudEvents extension fields. (2) TSD S7 T-A.1 publishes the module's two operations with request and answer element names and no property list, and no source publishes the rwb-source-data payment read, the rwb-case reference-data read or the P8 posting activity, so three names are placeholders. (3) partner carries DF-PRT-001 to DF-PRT-007 and no fee-basis field and no owner in a source this story may read; the fee element is therefore declared as a consumed reference-data row under the default ruling. (4) No source publishes a REST operation that moves a case state on behalf of a stage, so the case move is declared as the child-workflow outcome. (5) TSD S7 T3.2 is an empty list-of-values table, so the baseline publishes no enumeration, and T-A.2 gives status codes with no message id per condition. (6) The step publishes no event, so a baseline that fixes the service's event surface has to declare WriteOffApproved as another story's and leave the recovery without one. (7) The plan's C, I and X rows of this slice are empty while the contract declares two consumed rows and one consumed event.
evidence: TSD S7 T-A.1 and T-A.2, T3.1 and T3.2, T5.1, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1 and T6.2; FSD S7 A2.15.3.3 roles ('None; runs unattended', Credit Administration officer) and A2.15.4 exception flows; legacy RWB-E6-027 Data, Endpoints, Permission checks and Validation tables; context pack naming rules, ownership rows and connection matrix row S7; Template and Rules v1 R5.4 and R5.5
area: Contract surface, element definitions and interface names
proposed: Publish the element baseline with the placeholders, derive every fake from the published document, declare the case boundary as the child workflow's outcome, declare the fee element as a consumed reference-data row with the fee reference on the record only, bind every error condition to one message id of section 14, and confirm the event name, the payload and the three operation names with the owners before the tag

title: R-WO-37's agency fee calculation is also FEAT-PRM-07 of rwb-partner, and neither the plan's C rows nor DP-04, DP-07, DP-09 and DP-16 carry what the recovery step consumes
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.3 and R9; split plan slices RWB-S7-E6027-APP and RWB-S7-E6027-CON; context pack S7 rwb-writeoff (service row, ownership rows, naming rules, Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13, Temporal and Drools slides 5, 12 and 13); legacy RWB-E6-027; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A1.1, A1.2, A1.4, A2.15 and Screens; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T2, T3.0, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.1, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1, T6.2, T7, T-A.1 and T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-37, R-WO-49 and R-WO-50; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 rows FEAT-WOF-15, FEAT-WOF-16 and FEAT-PRM-06, FEAT-PRM-07
section: Metadata (Contract dependencies, Patterns applied); Sections 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 12.2, 12.4, 12.5 and 13
description: (1) Conflict of ownership: Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 gives R-WO-37 the action 'Post the recovery as post charge-off income and calculate the agency fee', while the Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 gives S9 the feature FEAT-PRM-07 'Match a recovery and calculate the agency fee' (split slice RWB-S9-E6035-APP) and FEAT-PRM-06 the placement (RWB-S9-E6034-APP). No source says which service owns the fee amount, the fee basis or the fee posting, and write_off has no fee column. (2) The connection matrix row S7 names only P7 (Temporal), P8 (Temporal and events) and P1 (REST and events); it names no cell for P3, P4 or S9, while the step needs the case move, the fee schedule, the ACE facts and the authorise guard. (3) DP-04 (embedded Drools and the rule package from rwb-decision), DP-07 (reference data contract), DP-09 (outbox and inbox) and DP-16 (rwb-integration contract) all appear in the sources of this key and none is in the plan's pattern set, so no H or C row records them. (4) TSD S7 T5.3 publishes one event for the module, which cannot carry both the approval and the recovery without an allocation step. (5) The plan's C row is None for both slices although the consumed rows are class C in fact.
evidence: Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 row R-WO-37 action; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 rows FEAT-PRM-06 and FEAT-PRM-07 for module S9 and FEAT-WOF-15 for module S7; split plan slices RWB-S7-E6034, RWB-S7-E6035 and RWB-S9-E6035; context pack connection matrix row S7 and naming rules; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 rows DP-04, DP-07, DP-09 and DP-16 and R5.4 class C; TSD S7 T3.1 and T5.3
area: Ownership of the agency fee, dependency classes and pattern coverage
proposed: Keep the income posting and the recovery on rwb-writeoff and the fee calculation on rwb-partner (FEAT-PRM-07), consume the fee schedule as reference data at its version and record the fee reference in the decision record only; record DP-04, DP-07, DP-09 and DP-16 as dependencies the plan does not hold; keep the plan's C row as None and build against the published documents and fakes on Day 1; raise the fee ownership question to the solution architect before the baseline tag
